## 2026-09-17: SLURP v2 base program cells B7r and B7c, on cell B7a's configuration

Cells **B7r** and **B7c** of `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-17-node-context-policy-design.md` section 15 (coordinator resolutions 2 and 3; owner decision 12 of 2026-09-17), each ONE
one-factor step **on top of cell B7a** (`configs/baseline/slurp-native-anchor-ncp-l1-train-fold-a-v1.json`, the Node Context Policy at level L1 on the sealed dual-store anchor). Cell B7a
has **not flown** at registration time: it is the primary comparator for both cells and **neither cell opens before B7a seals and is read not HARMFUL**. The released TRAIN A direct anchor
is the secondary comparator. Registration package: `docs/readiness/2026-09-17-slurp-b7rc-ncp-anchor-v1/`; preregistration `docs/readiness/2026-09-17-slurp-b7rc-ncp-anchor-v1-preregistration.md`.

**B7r** declares the review-finding PRODUCER format `saea-review-findings-v1` so the `planner:review-finding` and `solver:review-finding` boundaries can render structured findings instead
of the FALLBACK-RAW block on the rows whose Reviewer output parses. **B7c** moves the four `<role>:tool-observation` boundaries to level `structured`, so a replayed task-contract observation
is rendered by reference instead of echoing the 5,424-character contract the request's own system message already carries.

Neither cell adds a model contact. Proved model-free over all 5,417 sealed anchor requests through the production render path, against cell B7a's own registered render: B7r is byte-identical
on 5,417 of 5,417 contacts (its only static difference is an 898-character `response_format` DECODING parameter on the 2,167 Reviewer contacts and a 9-character program-id provenance string
per rendered state id); B7c rewrites 1,102 of 2,184 tool-observation rows at **-6,033 characters each, -6,648,366 characters over the run**, leaves 1,082 raw as the Reviewer's own live tool
chain, and leaves all 5,417 control envelopes and every non-agent-state history part identical. Both cells' prepared Perception supply reproduces the sealed anchor preparation's `output`
block on all 1,080 rows and the four-row reference on its 4.

**These eight rows are registered before contact and all four cells stay `held`.** The margins are the TRAIN A own-null half-widths measured by cell B0r, h_SLU 1.1218 pp and h_intent 1.0051 pp.
A NEUTRAL B7c enters the SLURP default plan because it lowers cost; a NEUTRAL B7r does not (design section 15 resolution 5).

## 2026-09-17 - SLURP v2 cell B2 v3 four-row smoke recovery on the E2d-fixed code (anchor base)

The cell B2 v3 four-row smoke `SAEA-SLURP-NATIVE-SAMPLES5-ANCHOR-SMOKE-4-V3` (attempt
`attempt-slurp-native-samples5-anchor-smoke-4-generation-v3`, flight commit `858ae4ea`) generated
**all 36 of its registered contacts** -- 95.360063 repeated speech seconds and 36 request-fit
receipts on all four rows -- and then **failed AT THE SEAL**. `core.bundle.outputs` refused row
`slurp:train:000007:audio--1504197557` with invariant **I7**: "text does not match its recorded
`response_text_sha256` -- the text was mutated after the model response was recorded (I7)". A
grouped Solver row's delivered text is the registered commit policy's aggregate over the five raw
samples and equals none of them, while the pre-E2d runner bound the row's `response_text_sha256` to
the LAST RAW sample's text hash. The worker died at the seal and never settled its attempt; root
reconciled the OPENED attempt to ABORTED through the repository's own
`core.attempts.store.AttemptStore.abort_if_opened`, actuals preserved (receipt
`coordination/slurp-b2-samples5-anchor-v3/attempt-reconciliation-smoke-v1.json`). The 36 calls and
95.360063 speech seconds stay charged to that CLOSED run id; its run directory is read-only evidence
and neither its run id nor its attempt id is ever reused. No scorer ran and no partial quality read
was taken or is permitted.

The fix is **E2d** (commit `f3a77fb0`, merged `5492c2af`, invariant **I7g**): the runner records
`solver_group.commit_params` and binds a grouped row's `response_text_sha256` to the DELIVERED
bytes, and the verifier binds every raw sample to the trace's own `MODEL_RESPONSE` bytes, resolves
the named commit policy in `core.base.COMMIT_POLICIES` and re-derives the delivered bytes through
`analysis.native_commit_replay`. I7 is unchanged and a samples-1 row is byte-identical to before.
E2d was validated read-only against these very bytes: `verify_bundle` still refuses them (their row
form is the pre-E2d one and their receipts carry no `commit_params`), while the per-sample trace
binding passes on 4 of 4 rows and the commit recomputation reproduces all four delivered texts byte
for byte. So the custody is sound, only the row form was wrong, and no sealed byte is edited.

**These two rows are the ONE root-diagnosed recovery re-registration the v3 preregistration section
10 allows for cell B2.** Nothing else moves: the same four rows, roster and split, the same policy
fragment with `max_contacts` 19, the same role graph, prompts, knowledge stores, supply contract,
speech packets, model fragment, resident geometry and caps, and the same moved channel
(`native_episode.roles.solver` at `samples` 5, temperature 0.7, seed offset 0, commit
`saea-commit-plurality-support-v1` at `min_support` 3 / char-F1 0.8, seeds 1249110493..1249110497).
The recovery baseline is the v3 smoke baseline unchanged except its `what_this_is`, its own
`native_contact_fit` identity, its own speech-feature identity strings and its own prepared-supply
pin -- ten composed keys differ, all bookkeeping, and all 56 model-facing keys are byte-identical.
Proved before contact over the failed attempt's own 36 sealed `MODEL_REQUEST` payloads: none of the
twelve run, attempt and speech-feature identity strings of either registration appears in any
payload byte, and each payload's own `key_representation_id`/`matcher_policy_id` is program-derived.
Readiness stays `held`; the arm and the twin stay `held` too and must be re-pinned on the fixed
commit before launch. A second failure closes cell B2. Full statement:
[`docs/readiness/2026-09-17-slurp-b2-samples5-anchor-v3-recovery-v1.md`](readiness/2026-09-17-slurp-b2-samples5-anchor-v3-recovery-v1.md).

## 2026-09-17 - SLURP v2 cell B7a recovery on the E8c-fixed code (anchor base)

Cell B7a's arm `SAEA-SLURP-NATIVE-NCP-L1-ANCHOR-TRAIN-FOLD-A-V1` (flight commit `00483f61`)
**ABORTED** at about 21:00 UTC on 2026-09-17 after 3,278 contacts over 618 rows, with
`NativeEpisodeError: Planner output names no registered action`. Of the attempt's 665 Planner
responses 663 were exactly `ACCEPT` or `REVISE`; one was the six-character token `REJECT` and
one an 80-character response. `reproduction.ojw.native_episode._planner_action` had no designed
behaviour for either -- the sealed anchor's own 1,085 Planner contacts never produced one -- so
it raised and the exception killed the campaign. 3,278 generation calls and 8,973.150063
repeated speech seconds are durably spent against that run id, which is now closed and never
reused. **No score ran and no partial quality read was taken or is permitted.** The four-row
smoke could not have caught it: all six of its Planner responses named a registered action.

The fix is **E8c** (commit `2af5955a`, merged `5bbd54a2`): `_planner_action` returns the
reserved routing value `PLANNER_ACTION_ILLEGAL`, the episode graph routes it to the same
explicit-accept component an `ACCEPT` takes, and the row is **RETAINED** -- it delivers its
committed draft unchanged, contacts no further role, spends no revision, counts toward every
budget it consumed, and records disposition `planner_action_illegal` with the action sha256 and
character count. An illegal Planner action is a row disposition, never a flight failure. These
four rows are the one root-diagnosed recovery re-registration the preregistration section 10
allows for this run. Nothing else moves: same roster, split, role graph, prompts, policy
templates, context policy, knowledge stores, supply geometry, speech packets, caps, geometry
and resident session. The whole 1,080-row roster is re-flown from row one. Readiness stays
`held`, and the verdict must report the flight's own `planner_action_illegal` count as a
diagnostic. Full statement:
[`docs/readiness/2026-09-17-slurp-b7a-ncp-l1-anchor-v1-recovery-v1.md`](readiness/2026-09-17-slurp-b7a-ncp-l1-anchor-v1-recovery-v1.md).

## 2026-09-18: SLURP v2 base program cell B5e, the early combination of modules M1 and M4b

**CELL B5e REGISTERED BEFORE CONTACT -- THE EARLY COMBINATION OF THE TWO ADMITTED MODULES, ORDERED BY
OWNER DECISION 19 OF 2026-09-18.** Module M1 (speech-keyed annotated TRAIN exemplars supplied to the
Solver) was admitted on 2026-09-18 when its derangement twin closed under owner decision 18 branch A;
module M4b (the date/time slot-contract revision, slot store v2) was admitted on 2026-09-17 and is
provisional until its request-identical replicate closes. Neither has ever flown beside the other. Owner
decision 19 put their combination in front of the rest of decision 15's order because the arithmetic
reaches the program bar -- v3-projected 62.67 + 2.06 = 64.73 against a bar of 64.00, with intent already
3.76 points clear -- and decision 21 put the B4b replicate immediately before it. That arithmetic is an
EXTRAPOLATION, not a measurement: the two modules plausibly overlap, since the twenty exemplars carry
date and time filler surfaces of their own and the v2 cards revise the date and time contracts. This cell
measures the combination once and reads it once. Four rows follow: the four-row form smoke and its FIT
row, and the 1,080-row arm and its FIT row. All four stay `consumed = no` and both cells stay readiness
HELD until the coordinator mints the root decision receipt and flips them. Full statement:
[`docs/readiness/2026-09-18-slurp-b5e-combination-v1-preregistration.md`](readiness/2026-09-18-slurp-b5e-combination-v1-preregistration.md).

## 2026-09-18 - SLURP v2 cell B5e recovery after the scheduled-task power-scheme abort (anchor base)

Cell B5e's arm `SAEA-SLURP-NATIVE-B5E-EXEMPLARS-K20-SLOT-STORE-V2-ANCHOR-TRAIN-FOLD-A-V1` aborted at
2026-09-18T14:40:20Z after **25 contacts (5 complete rows)** and 63.72893749999999 repeated speech
seconds. The task-owned resident server died mid-request because all three SAEA Windows Scheduled
Tasks carry the default stop-on-battery condition and stopped the instant the coordinator changed the
power scheme with `powercfg`. Host memory was 45.6 GB free, there was no OOM and no harness or config
error: the root cause is **infrastructure and coordinator-caused**, and code, configuration and
request bytes are unchanged. An earlier launch of 03:32Z died with the machine shutdown of 03:36Z
before opening any attempt and carries no exposure. The fix is outside this repository -- the tasks
were re-registered with the battery and idle conditions disabled and no execution time limit, and the
resident session was restarted under the same session id.

These two rows are **the one root-diagnosed recovery re-registration** the preregistration (sections 7
and 11) allows for this run, as a **full re-fly** of all 1,080 rows. The aborted run id and its FIT
row are closed (`consumed = yes`) and are never reused; no row is filtered and none is carried over.
Nothing in the science moves, and **no new smoke is registered** -- the four-row smoke sealed with a
structural PASS at study commit `878dd5c6` and the aborted arm realized the same form on the full
roster before the server died. Clause 1 of the decision rule reads the **official unprojected** number
under owner decision 23. Readiness stays `held`. Full statement:

## 2026-09-19 - SLURP v2 cell B7a v2, after the v1 flight closed on its second failure (anchor base)

**CELL B7a IS RE-REGISTERED AS v2 -- THE V1 FLIGHT IS CLOSED AND MEASURED NOTHING.** The v1 arm
aborted on an illegal Planner action on 2026-09-17 and the one root-diagnosed recovery the
preregistration allows aborted again on 2026-09-19 at 1,451 contacts, when a single Reviewer
completion hit the 512-token `max512` cap and the episode's DEFAULT finite-completion policy
`raise` propagated the error out of the campaign. Section 8 of the recovery note and the owner
iteration rule close that flight: no third registration under v1, no replay, no row filtering,
and the fix proven on a four-row dry run first. **Four rows follow: the four-row form smoke and
its FIT row, and the 1,080-row arm and its FIT row.** The only configuration difference from the
closed v1 recovery is `native_episode.finite_completion_policy = deliver-latest-or-abstain`, a
harness-robustness key that renders no request byte. Rows whose `terminal_disposition.reason` is
`finite_completion` are RETAINED and scored as delivered, never filtered, and their count and
role breakdown are a mandatory diagnostic in the verdict. Readiness stays `held` until the
coordinator mints `coordination/slurp-b7a-ncp-l1-anchor-v2/root-admission-v2.json` (decision id
`slurp-b7a-ncp-l1-anchor-admission-v2`) and flips both cells with
`scripts/flights/repin_cell.py`. Closure record:
[`docs/results/2026-09-19-slurp-b7a-v1-closure.md`](results/2026-09-19-slurp-b7a-v1-closure.md).

Closure record docs/results/2026-09-19-slurp-b7a-v1-closure.md. ROOT CAUSE: the SLURP native baselines omit native_episode.finite_completion_policy and rails/native_episode_config.py defaults it to "raise" (raw.get("finite_completion_policy", "raise")), so one truncated completion kills the campaign; the alternative deliver-latest-or-abstain is already implemented and tested (reproduction.ojw.native_episode._finite_terminal_outcome, rails.native_episode_receipt, rails.runner, core.flight.runtime) and retains the row with terminal_disposition.reason finite_completion, delivering the latest delivery-eligible Solver draft or an abstention. THE ONLY CONFIGURATION DIFFERENCE from the closed v1 recovery is that one episode key, plus the bookkeeping identity every new registration carries: what_this_is, this cell's native_contact_fit run and attempt ids at the unchanged endpoint ceilings, its own two speech-feature identity ids (trace provenance only), and the experiment fragment's own ids, date, purpose, failure_policy, generation_budget definition and readiness block. REQUEST BYTES ARE IDENTICAL: the key is read by rails.runner when it builds NativeEpisodeSpec and is never serialised into a payload, and the v1 recovery's request-envelope comparison already proved over 3278 sealed MODEL_REQUEST payloads that no run, attempt or speech-feature identity string reaches a payload byte and that each payload's own key_representation_id/matcher_policy_id is derived from the policy id. The four-row smoke proves it in flight by reproducing the sealed v1 recovery smoke SAEA-SLURP-NATIVE-NCP-L1-ANCHOR-SMOKE-4-RECOVERY-V1's MODEL_REQUEST digests (that trace is read only, never written, and no answer, reference or quality field of it is read). Roster, split, role graph, prompts, policy templates, context policy at level L1 on the same eight boundaries, knowledge stores, supply geometry, speech packets, caps, geometry and resident session are the v1 recovery's, unchanged; the whole 1080-row roster flies from row one and no row of either aborted attempt is reused, filtered, scored or read -- their 3278 and 1451 calls and 8973.150063 and 3830.12 repeated speech seconds are charged to their own closed run ids. NEW MANDATORY DIAGNOSTIC: rows whose terminal_disposition.reason is finite_completion are RETAINED and scored as delivered (Solver draft or abstention), never filtered, and the verdict must report their count, their sample ids and the by-role / by-stage / by-finish-reason breakdown analysis.native_episode_diagnostics emits as finite_stops; the v1 recovery's planner_action_illegal diagnostic is inherited unchanged. Under owner decision 22 of 2026-09-18 the ONE recovery this flight is allowed takes the RESUME-RECOVERY form (its own experiment fragment with resume_from {attempt_id, trace_sha256}, same run id, core.flight.resume replaying the predecessor trace model-free); the registered cap is run-cumulative and covers it. A SECOND FAILURE CLOSES THIS FLIGHT on the same terms as v1. Readiness is held and the coordinator flips it with scripts/flights/repin_cell.py after minting coordination/slurp-b7a-ncp-l1-anchor-v2/root-admission-v2.json (decision id slurp-b7a-ncp-l1-anchor-admission-v2); the inherited prepared_phase_supply pin names the closed v1 recovery artifact and will NOT verify against the v2 digest -- core.flight.repin.ensure_artifact_pinned rebuilds it under prepared/<v2 run id>/ and asserts its output block equals the inherited one's, and --allow-output-change is never passed. Composed and protocol hashes are the values of the v2 fragments exactly as committed (readiness held, inherited preparation requirement present, no decision requirement); flipping readiness and appending the decision requirement re-pin them. ## 2026-09-19 - SLURP efficiency cell EFF-1, constant native tool-schema rendering (anchor base)

**EFF-1 IS AN EFFICIENCY CELL: ITS PURPOSE IS THROUGHPUT AND ITS ADMISSION RULE IS NEUTRAL.** The
SLURP flights are prefill-bound, and the dominant cause of the prefilled token count is that the
native `tools` block toggles on at the first Reviewer contact and off at the Planner contact,
invalidating the pinned slot's whole KV prefix twice per row -- speech packet included -- for
**26,197 prefilled tokens per row** measured on the B4b replicate. Item E17 (merged at `d6fade1e`)
built the switch that holds the rendering constant; owner decision 41 of 2026-09-19 put the
measurement on the queue. **Four rows follow: the four-row form smoke and its FIT row, and the
1,080-row arm and its FIT row.** The only model-facing configuration difference from the sealed
anchor is `native_episode.tool_schema_rendering = "constant"`; the second declared key,
`native_episode.finite_completion_policy`, renders no request byte and is required of every live
SLURP native cell by `scripts/checks/finite_completion_policy_check.py`. **An efficiency cell does
not count toward owner decision 30's headroom trigger.** All four cells stay readiness `held`
until the coordinator mints
`coordination/slurp-eff1-tool-constant-v1/root-admission-v1.json` (decision id
`slurp-eff1-tool-constant-admission-v1`) and flips them with `scripts/flights/repin_cell.py`. Full

[`docs/readiness/2026-09-19-slurp-eff1-tool-constant-v1-preregistration.md`](readiness/2026-09-19-slurp-eff1-tool-constant-v1-preregistration.md).

WHAT THE CELL IS: efficiency cell EFF-1, the constant native tool-schema rendering of item E17 (merged at d6fade1e), which is lever L1 of docs/results/2026-09-19-slurp-throughput-root-cause-v1.md. ONE FACTOR against the SEALED dual-store anchor: native_episode.tool_schema_rendering, "per-role" (the key's ABSENCE, which IS the anchor's configuration) -> "constant". Armed, every role contact of a row renders the SAME tools array -- the union of the schemas any role may call, which for this episode IS the Reviewer's own single saea-tool-task-contract-v1 array -- so the Qwen3-Omni chat template's system message never changes inside a row and the pinned per-sample slot's KV prefix survives the role handover. The Reviewer's request bytes therefore do not move at all; perception, solver and planner gain exactly one key, tools, with tool_choice still "none". AUTHORITY IS NOT WIDENED: tool_names is unchanged per role, the framework advertises a tool-free role no ability, and _RoleAuthorityRail still refuses a call it emits anyway. THE PURPOSE OF THIS CELL IS THROUGHPUT, NOT EFFECT. The SLURP flights are PREFILL-BOUND (488-536 s per million prefilled tokens across four sealed native runs, a 5 % spread) and the dominant cause is prefix-cache breakage: with one slot pinned per row the tools block toggles on at contact 3 and off at contact 5, and each toggle invalidates the whole KV prefix, speech packet included (re-decoded on 100 % of first-Reviewer and Planner contacts). Measured on the B4b replicate: 26,197 prefilled tokens per row, positions 2 and 4 carrying 63.5 % of it. Expected after the key: about 13,065 prefilled tokens per row (-50.1 %) and about 1.9 GPU hours per 1,080 rows against the anchor's 3.388. PRIMARY DELIVERABLES, read from the sealed receipts, trace and manifest and from the resident session's own server.log joined PER SLOT exactly as the throughput report joins them: prefilled prompt tokens per row (prompt tokens minus cached), contacts per row, GPU hours per 1,080 rows, slot occupancy, utilisation, the per-position table (perception / solver / reviewer 1 / reviewer 2 / planner) beside the anchor-era reference, and tool_schema_rendering.distinct_tool_schemas_sha256 == 1 on every row. ONE NUMBER IS EXPECTED TO RISE AND THAT IS NOT A REGRESSION: client-visible prompt tokens per row, because three contacts gain the tools block (the anchor's measured value is 42,591 per row). Prompt volume is not the cost; prefilled tokens are. ADMISSION RULE: NEUTRAL. Official pooled SLU micro F1 and intent (joint scenario+action) accuracy must be NON-INFERIOR against the sealed anchor SAEA-SLURP-NATIVE-DUAL-STORE-TRAIN-FOLD-A-ANCHOR-RECOVERY-V1 (scores 73608763, outputs d87d71e8, run manifest 049ac230, all three RE-DERIVED by hashing the sealed files in this registration; official 48.53 / 77.96) at the own-null margins h_SLU 1.1218 and h_intent 1.0051 -- owner decision 38's registered FALLBACK, cell B0r's own null on this exact roster and geometry, because this cell has no replicate -- with each CI95 LOWER bound above -h. HARMFUL is read FIRST under owner decision 25 Method B: a MEASURED LOSS, a point estimate below -h or a CI95 upper bound below zero. NON-INFERIORITY NOT PROVEN if an interval is so wide that its lower bound falls below -h without a point estimate below -h; the remedy is the configuration's own replicate, not a re-read. THERE IS NO ADMITTED-ON-A-GAIN CLAUSE: a positive interval would be reported as a fact and explicitly not claimed as an effect of a rendering key. The per-scenario band (owner decision 17) is a DIAGNOSTIC the verdict must carry, not an extra gate. THE EFFICIENCY NUMBERS ARE REPORTED WHATEVER THE VERDICT WORD IS. AN EFFICIENCY CELL DOES NOT COUNT TOWARD OWNER DECISION 30's HEADROOM TRIGGER, and the verdict says so in those words. If NEUTRAL, native_episode.tool_schema_rendering = "constant" ENTERS THE SLURP DEFAULT PLAN (design section 15 resolution 5: a NEUTRAL switch enters only if it lowers cost; this one does), EVERY LATER CELL AND THE TEST READ ADOPT IT, and from that moment A LATER CELL REGISTERED AGAINST A SEALED PER-ROLE ARM MUST SAY SO -- the same clause the B8a package used for the delivery node. ORDER: L1 is evaluated BEFORE L2 (drop the Planner) and L3 (shrink the evidence block), because four fifths of the Planner's apparent cost is this toggle and evaluating L2 first would credit it with L1's gain. SECOND DECLARED KEY, NOT A FACTOR: native_episode.finite_completion_policy = deliver-latest-or-abstain, required of every live SLURP native cell by scripts/checks/finite_completion_policy_check.py (item E13). It renders NO request byte and only decides whether a finite completion aborts the flight or the row is RETAINED with a terminal_disposition reason finite_completion. UNIQUELY HERE ITS ASYMMETRY IS CLOSED RATHER THAN DECLARED: the comparator IS the sealed anchor and docs/receipts/slurp-finite-completion-exposure-v1.json is the registered receipt proving ZERO finite completions on it, so the comparator side is provably unaffected. The count on this arm stays a mandatory diagnostic; the expected count is zero; no row is ever filtered out. PREPARED SUPPLY: THIS CELL'S OWN, built model-free in this registration with core.flight.cli prepare-supply under each cell's own run id, rather than inherited -- because artifact identity binds the implementation modules (item E16) and an inherited pin trips core.flight.repin.assert_no_residue against the donor's own committed fragments. Smoke prepared/SAEA-SLURP-NATIVE-TOOL-CONSTANT-ANCHOR-SMOKE-4-V1/phase-supply-v1.json (b46ce333), output 512583ec on 4 of 4 rows, the shared four-row reference. Both matched exactly and both pins were re-verified on the warm branch. --allow-output-change must never be passed. MANDATORY DIAGNOSTICS: finite-completion rows with their sample ids and the delivered/abstained split; planner_action_illegal with sample ids, action character counts and SHA-256 values; FIRST-REQUEST BYTE IDENTITY STATED HONESTLY -- the Perception request is NOT byte-identical to the anchor's because the tools array is added to it, and what is claimed instead is that every REVIEWER request is byte-identical to the anchor's at the same position of the same sample id and the other three roles differ in EXACTLY the tools key with tool_choice still none, proven on the smoke by comparing request payloads; the per-row constancy table with authority_tool_names beside rendered_tool_names; the native task-contract call count against the anchor's realized 1,082 plus any call emitted by a role holding no authority (expected zero, refused by the rail, reported per role); per-scenario intent and SLU over all 18 scenarios in both weightings with net harmed rows flagged at five; row accounting 1,080 in / 1,080 out on both sides; and the full cost block against the anchor's realized 5,417 contacts, 15,459.764875 audio seconds and 3.388 GPU hours. RESAMPLING: paired whole-speaker cluster bootstrap, 10,000 draws, seed 20260915, CI95 for the clauses and CI90 for diagnostics; sensitivity paired scenario-stratified row bootstrap, same draws and seed; every table in both the natural-mixture and the equal-scenario weighting. Projection v3 and the TRAIN symmetric number are reported beside every official number and the OFFICIAL unprojected number decides (owner decision 23). Read ONCE; no repeat-to-pass. FAILURE RULE: stop and preserve on the first failure; no retry, replay, row filtering, roster, role-graph, prompt, geometry or cap change; AT MOST ONE root-diagnosed recovery re-registration per flight and a second failure closes it; RESUME-RECOVERY CLAUSE under owner decision 22 -- an infrastructure death with code and request bytes unchanged may be recovered as a resume-recovery under item E10, keeping every complete row without selection, re-flying every partial or unstarted row under the same run id, declaring the predecessor attempt with its trace hash and kept-row list, changing no question, roster, factor, comparator, decision rule or cap, and re-checking the run-cumulative budget; and, specific to an efficiency cell, a resumed read must state the SPLIT of its GPU hours and prefilled tokens across attempts, because a merged manifest's cost is the sum of two lease windows. NOT CLAIMED: no effectiveness claim; no superiority, generalization, paper-scale or held-out claim; no claim about Earnings or Audio2Tool; no claim that the Planner or the Reviewer is intrinsically expensive; no geometry claim (np6/np8 and -ub stay out of scope); no claim that the predicted 50.1 % is the realized saving; no claim about what three more roles do with the tool definitions; nothing about any in-flight cell; and a structural smoke result is never a quality result. NO check receipt is on file and that is deliberate: FlightRuntime.preflight asserts a clean study tree and reserves the attempt, so the composed and protocol hashes were computed directly through core.config.compose / core.config.protocol_hash and THE METHOD WAS VERIFIED ON THIS TREE against cell B7a v2's own registered values (composed 73a817ff / protocol f5a6733f for its arm, fbe7556e / 1f3bdd15 for its smoke). core.flight.cli wire-check remains unavailable for any native-episode cell; the substitutes are tests/unit/test_eff1_tool_constant_config.py and tests/unit/test_e17_constant_tool_rendering.py, which drive the real OpenJiuwen role graph and the real render path over the shared fake transport. Composed and protocol hashes are the values of the five fragments exactly as committed (readiness HELD, this cell's OWN preparation requirement pinned, NO decision requirement); re-pinning, adding the decision requirement and flipping readiness each change them. ONE FACTOR against the SEALED dual-store anchor: native_episode.tool_schema_rendering, "per-role" (the key's ABSENCE, which IS the anchor's configuration) -> "constant". Armed, every role contact of a row renders the SAME tools array -- the union of the schemas any role may call, which for this episode IS the Reviewer's own single saea-tool-task-contract-v1 array -- so the Qwen3-Omni chat template's system message never changes inside a row and the pinned per-sample slot's KV prefix survives the role handover. The Reviewer's request bytes therefore do not move at all; perception, solver and planner gain exactly one key, tools, with tool_choice still "none". AUTHORITY IS NOT WIDENED: tool_names is unchanged per role, the framework advertises a tool-free role no ability, and _RoleAuthorityRail still refuses a call it emits anyway. THE PURPOSE OF THIS CELL IS THROUGHPUT, NOT EFFECT. The SLURP flights are PREFILL-BOUND (488-536 s per million prefilled tokens across four sealed native runs, a 5 % spread) and the dominant cause is prefix-cache breakage: with one slot pinned per row the tools block toggles on at contact 3 and off at contact 5, and each toggle invalidates the whole KV prefix, speech packet included (re-decoded on 100 % of first-Reviewer and Planner contacts). Measured on the B4b replicate: 26,197 prefilled tokens per row, positions 2 and 4 carrying 63.5 % of it. Expected after the key: about 13,065 prefilled tokens per row (-50.1 %) and about 1.9 GPU hours per 1,080 rows against the anchor's 3.388. PRIMARY DELIVERABLES, read from the sealed receipts, trace and manifest and from the resident session's own server.log joined PER SLOT exactly as the throughput report joins them: prefilled prompt tokens per row (prompt tokens minus cached), contacts per row, GPU hours per 1,080 rows, slot occupancy, utilisation, the per-position table (perception / solver / reviewer 1 / reviewer 2 / planner) beside the anchor-era reference, and tool_schema_rendering.distinct_tool_schemas_sha256 == 1 on every row. ONE NUMBER IS EXPECTED TO RISE AND THAT IS NOT A REGRESSION: client-visible prompt tokens per row, because three contacts gain the tools block (the anchor's measured value is 42,591 per row). The per-scenario band (owner decision 17) is a DIAGNOSTIC the verdict must carry, not an extra gate. THE EFFICIENCY NUMBERS ARE REPORTED WHATEVER THE VERDICT WORD IS. show the structured review-finding boundaries falling back to raw on 100 % of rows: the audit

the boundary is raw -- so the ON arm's only request-byte difference from the anchor is the block
itself, on the Reviewer contacts. **Four rows follow: the four-row form smoke and its FIT row, and
the 1,080-row arm and its FIT row.** Beside the one factor both cells declare
`native_episode.finite_completion_policy = deliver-latest-or-abstain`, a harness-robustness key
that renders no request byte; rows whose `terminal_disposition.reason` is `finite_completion` are

## 2026-09-19 - SLURP cell B1r, the request-identical replicate of the exemplar-supply cell (module M1)

**CELL B1r CHANGES NOTHING, AND THAT IS THE POINT.** Module M1 -- the speech-keyed annotated TRAIN
exemplar supply to the Solver, plain top-k = 20 -- is ADMITTED but PROVISIONAL with its replication
obligation `UNMET`, and its requirement names exactly one discharging form: *a request-identical
replicate of this cell (about 3.7 GPU hours)*. The B5e leg did not discharge it. **Owner decision 37
of 2026-09-19** ruled that the replicate flies before the base lock closes and that **module M1
enters the SLURP default plan only if it replicates**. This cell is also the only way to obtain the
margins **owner decision 38** now requires: the exemplar-supplied configuration has no
request-identical replicate, so every contrast against an exemplar-supplied arm has been borrowing a
review-off configuration's half-widths. **Four rows follow: the four-row form smoke and its FIT row,
and the 1,080-row arm and its FIT row.** The only configuration difference from the sealed cell B1
recovery arm is bookkeeping plus `native_episode.finite_completion_policy`, which renders no request
byte and is required of every live SLURP native cell by
`scripts/checks/finite_completion_policy_check.py`. **This cell keeps PER-ROLE tool-schema
rendering** -- request identity with cell B1 requires it -- so it is a per-role cell and is
unaffected by efficiency cell EFF-1's outcome. All four cells stay readiness `held` until the
coordinator mints `coordination/slurp-b1-replicate-v1/root-admission-v1.json` (decision id
`slurp-b1-replicate-admission-v1`) and flips them with `scripts/flights/repin_cell.py`. Full
statement:
[`docs/readiness/2026-09-19-slurp-b1-replicate-v1-preregistration.md`](readiness/2026-09-19-slurp-b1-replicate-v1-preregistration.md).

ROOT CAUSE. rails.controllers.seal_phase_response_state seals a role state from the model's OWN response bytes, and the Perception phase of this program answers under the registered slurp-intent-hypotheses-v1 structured-output contract, whose entire schema is required ['candidates'] with additionalProperties false. The sealed Perception state is therefore the COMPACT one-key document; the canonical four-key document (schema, semantics, sample_id, candidates) is the CONSUMPTION view, rebuilt at each reading site from those bytes plus that site's own trusted phase/sample identity. rails.knowledge_stores._stage3_delta_local_supply read it canonically, so three keys a native episode can never seal were missing. The sibling route on the same phase (slot-contracts candidate_supply.solver) declares compact_source_phase and was fine, which is why the sealed PLAN arm flew this very episode and this cell did not, and every unit test of the delta route fed it a canonical document, which is why the whole ladder was green. THE FIX (engineering only, no config key added, no decided key moved). _stage3_delta_local_supply now reads the candidate state through the COMPACT branch of rails.slurp_intent_hypotheses.parse_slurp_intent_hypothesis_state whenever the candidate state phase DECLARES the slurp-intent-hypotheses-v1 contract, and canonically otherwise -- the same question rails.slot_binding_view already answers off the same declared field. The parser stays strict both ways: under the compact contract the canonical document is a refusal, and the compact branch additionally binds state_kind/state_id to that phase and sample. PROVEN OFFLINE BEFORE THIS FLIGHT by analysis.native_episode_dry_run, which walks this exact composition node by node (perception -> solver -> reviewer -> planner -> delivery) on the real released stores with canned, schema-valid role answers and ZERO model, tool, network, GPU, gate, transport, client or attempt contacts: pre-fix it reproduces the flight's own error sentence, post-fix every node is supplied its own node_target slice (Perception 4 seeded, Solver 8, Reviewer 4, Planner 1 of cap 4) and the Solver's draft is delivered. Regression tests: tests/unit/test_native_episode_dry_run.py and tests/unit/test_stage3_delta_node_routes.py, whose Perception fixture now seals what a flight seals. RE-PIN OBLIGATION. rails/knowledge_stores.py is one of the five files whose SHA-256 is part of every prepared phase-supply artifact identity, so the fix invalidates the pinned first-phase artifact of all six CELL-1 cells; the coordinator re-pins each with scripts/flights/repin_cell.py, whose output is expected to reproduce byte for byte, and --allow-output-change must never be passed. This cell carries no committed prepared_phase_supply pin, so the re-pin mints its own under its own run id (item E16). Ceilings are bounds, never targets. THIRD REGISTRATION OF THIS SMOKE; THE v2 SMOKE RUN ID IS RETIRED. Run id SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-DELTA-CELL-SMOKE-4-V2 launched at 2026-09-23 17:07 UTC, METERED 12 contacts on the four rows (Perception + Solver + Reviewer on rows 1 and 3 to ACCEPT, Perception + Solver on rows 2 and 4) and died at the openJiuwen vertex reviewer_0_input with "acquire must introduce at least one new value or facet". The v1 run id before it failed twice and is likewise retired. Under the program's own rule (study CLAUDE.md, owner 2026-09-03) a failure is fixed and PROVEN on a four-row dry run before any further contact, so this NEW run id carries that proof. NO BUDGET MOVES: the caps are the v1 and v2 smokes', unchanged; they are run-cumulative per run id, so neither the v1 spend (4 calls, 10.60 s) nor the v2 spend (12 calls) is carried into this one. The retired rows are closed by the coordinator, not by this registration. ROOT CAUSE. The stage3-deltas store is NODE-ADDRESSED: its 379 values split into disjoint per-node slices (Perception 119, Solver 151, Reviewer 95, Planner 14), and the Reviewer slice associates with only 30 of the 39 legal intents. A candidate-bound route whose node slice matches NONE of the row's Perception candidates therefore selects nothing -- and the pre-fix rails.knowledge_stores._stage3_delta_local_supply still returned a PhaseSupply for it. rails.controllers.advance_phase_response_state makes ANY supply an action_kind=acquire transition, and rails.knowledge.AgentStepTransition.validate refuses an acquire that introduces neither a value nor a facet, so the episode died the moment the Reviewer's boundary was resolved. Rows 1 and 3 survived because their candidates do hit the Reviewer slice (3 and 2 deltas); rows 2 and 4 (iot_hue_* and play_* candidates) hit nothing there. The Solver never showed the defect because that phase composes THREE supplies (slot-contracts candidate_supply, train-exemplars phase_supply and this route) and a sibling always carried a value -- the Solver delta selection was in fact empty on rows 3 and 4 and went unnoticed; the Reviewer and the Planner are served by this store ALONE. Two things kept the ladder green: a unit test PINNED the defect as "an empty but valid supply", and the offline dry run's canned Perception answer was built from the store's UNION of addressed facets, walked only the roster's first row -- one of the two that completed -- and never walked a REVISE revisit. THE FIX (engineering only, no config key added, no decided key moved). A later-phase delta route that introduces nothing new now supplies NOTHING: the selection is ranked in full, the ids already in QueryState.retrieved_value_ids are dropped, the per-node cap is applied to what REMAINS, and an empty result returns None so the phase takes no supply step at all and the wave seals as an ordinary organize transition. The AgentStepTransition invariant stays strict. Each skip is receipted on the router as delta_supply {node, phase, sample_id, store_id, selected, already_acquired, reason}. On a first visit with nothing visible the selection is byte-identical to its pre-fix self. PROVEN OFFLINE BEFORE THIS FLIGHT by analysis.native_episode_dry_run, which walks this exact composition node by node on the real released stores with ZERO model, tool, network, GPU, gate, transport, client or attempt contacts, now on ALL FOUR rows with the candidate ids the v2 attempt's own trace recorded and with the runner's own repeat-visit restriction in the walk: pre-fix it reproduces the flight's own error sentence on rows 2 and 4 and completes rows 1 and 3, exactly as the flight did; post-fix all four rows complete (per-node deltas supplied: Perception 4 seeded on every row; Solver 1 / 4 / 0 / 0; Reviewer 3 / 0 / 2 / 0; Planner 1 / 0 / 1 / 0) and a REVISE walk revisits Solver, Reviewer and Planner acquiring nothing a second time. Regression tests: tests/unit/test_native_episode_dry_run.py (the real cell, all four rows, plus the REVISE path) and tests/unit/test_stage3_delta_supply_router.py (the router contract, the refused empty acquire, and the cap applied to new values). RE-PIN OBLIGATION. rails/knowledge_stores.py is one of the five files whose SHA-256 is part of every prepared phase-supply artifact identity (core.flight.runtime._phase_seed_inputs), so this fix invalidates the pinned first-phase artifact of every CELL-1 cell; the coordinator re-pins each with scripts/flights/repin_cell.py, whose output is expected to reproduce byte for byte, and --allow-output-change must never be passed. This cell carries no committed prepared_phase_supply pin, so the re-pin mints its own under its own run id (item E16). This step constructs no `contracts.ExecutionPlan` at all -- the plan validator requires finite POSITIVE calls, GPU hours and speech seconds by design, and a pass that touches no model must not reserve one contact of head-room -- so the allowance's execution-profile rule does not bind it. It is named in the allowance's `permitted_run_ids` and `preparation_run_ids` anyway, because it is a derivative of test-split media and its row must carry the owner's name like its parents. The CLI refuses to overwrite an existing output file, so a re-run against the same `--out-dir` / `--out-name` refuses rather than silently changing sealed bytes, and `--check` verifies without writing.
